speaker: william_shakespeare
text: If thou bringest the cord under the cross-turn first, Richard, the corners will not chafe when it goes up the street.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: It would be quicker if you stopped describing the knot.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: It holds. The skins are in. The money isn't. Same as always.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not buying, and I am not opening a bill.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: Nobody needs you to. Go and sort thy papers out of the window-seat before Mother sweeps.
